# OpenAI / Codex — captured 2026-09-02

# sources.json has developers.openai.com/codex/changelog, which 308-redirects here. Unfixed.

## NEWEST: 2026-09-01. Prior scan (08-30) read through the 2026-08-25 items.
## NEW SINCE: Codex CLI 0.150.0 (Aug 26), 0.150.1 (Aug 27), 0.151.0 (Aug 29), 0.152.0/0.152.1 (Sep 1),
## plus two ChatGPT iOS builds.

2026-09-01 Codex CLI 0.152.1 — "Guardian approval review now honors Node REPL policies provided
  through MODEL METADATA."  => a POLICY INPUT ARRIVING WITH THE MODEL rather than from local config.
2026-09-01 Codex CLI 0.152.0 — **per-tool MCP `output_token_limit` settings** (per-tool truncation =
  per-tool EVIDENCE LOSS for anything inspecting tool output); MCP server names now accept
  package-style formatting (`:`, `@`, `/`, `.`); credential-refresh progress display for
  **Amazon Bedrock reauthentication**; configurable app-server `thread/shellCommand` timeouts
  **EXCEEDING ONE HOUR**; planning tool now OPT-IN; Vim `/` and `?` search; rate-limit banners.
2026-08-29 Codex CLI 0.151.0 *** EXTENSION-LEVEL MCP TOOL RESULT INSPECTION/REPLACEMENT ***
  REPORTED 09-02 MEDIUM/AIDR. An extension can INSPECT **OR REPLACE** an MCP tool result BEFORE IT
  REACHES THE MODEL. Cuts both ways: a defensive integration point stronger than the hook surface,
  AND a supply-chain component with model-facing write access (a replaced result is indistinguishable
  from a genuine one). Same release: configurable grace period for OPTIONAL MCP server tool discovery;
  **plugin catalogs now COMBINE PER-REPOSITORY CONFIGURATION** while reporting invalid marketplaces
  separately => A REPOSITORY CAN CONTRIBUTE PLUGIN SOURCES to a developer's session
  (the agent-plugins-cross-vendor-standard pattern arriving in another client).
  Also: remote sandbox enforcement using EXECUTOR METADATA; structured MCP error preservation;
  nested SUBAGENT token budgeting; stale Guardian classification prevention.
2026-08-27 Codex CLI 0.150.1 — remote compaction counts retained images toward its token budget.
2026-08-26 Codex CLI 0.150.0 — **`@` task mentions "enabling agents to READ/CREATE/MESSAGE TASKS"**
  (agent-to-agent and agent-to-human comms through a channel not currently modelled);
  new **`Interrupt` hooks** for interrupted-turn commands and MCP handlers; `/copy` picker;
  automatic unnamed-task titling; clickable Markdown links; permission-mode cycle shortcuts.
  Fixes touching: untrusted project instructions, MANAGED DENY-READ ENFORCEMENT, CREDENTIAL REDACTION,
  REMOTE MCP BEARER-TOKEN RESOLUTION, Amazon Bedrock compaction/multi-agent compatibility.
2026-08-26 ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.230 — task search across connected hosts; Home Screen shortcuts for
  ChatGPT / Work / Codex Remote.
2026-09-01 ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.237 — cross-host attachments (Photo Library video), Priority view,
  queued prompt syncing with background sending, live working-time display, thread ID copying.

## ALREADY REPORTED 2026-08-26, do not re-report:
2026-08-25 Browser extensions on Edge/Brave/Opera/Vivaldi; desktop built-in browser **Site tools
  (WebMCP)** via GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra; CLOUD BROWSER SIGN-IN; scheduled tasks TRIGGERED BY
  Gmail / Slack / GitHub events; `codex mcp-server` deprecated in favour of the Codex app server.

## SDK STREAM — openai-python /releases and openai-node /releases (NEITHER IS IN sources.json)
python v3.7.0 (Sep 2) update usage APIs + docs; no repeated numpy validation for embeddings.
python v3.6.0 (Aug 28) **compute_units** added to response + chat completion usage metrics;
  **X.509 workload identity hardening**.
python v3.5.0 (Aug 27) function call output identifiers now OPTIONAL in API responses.
python v3.4.0 (Aug 26) **obfuscation field on ChatCompletionChunk**; **PROJECT RESIDENCY
  CONFIGURATION** and **cost units**; fixes to Realtime encoding, WebSocket redirects, Azure
  deployment-name encoding, SSE incremental decoding.
node v7.9.0 (Sep 2) usage APIs; WebSocket redirect prevention.
node v7.8.0 (Aug 27) compute_units on Responses + Chat Completions; default WebSocket User-Agent;
  **AUDIT LOG EVENTS**; workload identity refresh-buffer clamping; X.509 hardening.
=> library-level plumbing, held from the report but PARSER-RELEVANT: compute_units, cost units,
   project residency, obfuscation, audit log events.
